verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official Model Context Protocol server that lets users drive Adyen through natural language from their chosen LLM client. A probe confirms the dedicated MCP server docs page exists, so an agent can connect via a first-party MCP server. Missing for 10: details of which tools/APIs the server exposes (e.g. whether it covers the Agentic Commerce APIs), setup/auth and transport documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
